amendments.why: plan/registry row 17 (REPRODUCE, SAFETY and LEAN known open item): the .github/ copy differs from 17:.claude/skills/custom-fields-development/SKILL.md only by a trailing newline, so skill_routes.py verify (ws_norm_sha, fix2-commons 5) recomputes it as a mirror routed to the .claude/ canonical; the plan said variant. The venture station's router/skills.json row for this id must match: kind mirror, route_to the .claude/ canonical, no keywords of its own.

skills_assignment.census: SKILL_CENSUS.yml (360 files; 338 unique by content; 22 byte mirrors; 9 frontmatter unparsed)
skills_assignment.classification_rule: canonical = the one routed copy; mirror = census mirror_of (byte-identical); symlink = git mode 120000 (blob is the link text) -> routes to the target; variant = same (repo,name), different bytes -> routes to canonical but keeps its own row and held file; fixture = test/eval fixture path -> held file only, routed as fixture
